shortDescription: Fidelity began accepting payment for order flow for options more than 10 years ago. "Fidelity Adds Payment for Order Flow to Stock Trades — WSJ," at 10:33 a.m. ET on Aug. 26, incorrectly said it started the practice in 2022.
